name: AI Usage
author: Jim
description: Live usage for your AI subscriptions in the bar: Claude, OpenAI (ChatGPT/Codex), OpenCode Go/Zen, Antigravity, Conductor (AI Junction) and OpenRouter, with a tabbed popup and a setup tab to pick what to track.

barWidget.description: Rate-limit windows, spend and credit for each AI subscription you track. Click for a tab per provider; the SETUP tab chooses which providers appear.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: All: one figure per tracked provider. Worst: only the most-used window. Cycle: one provider every five seconds. Icon only: just the icon.

schema.label: Usage display
schema.description: Show used or remaining percentages in the bar and meters. Warnings always indicate usage near the limit.

schema.label: Warn at (% used)
schema.description: Turn the bar and meters urgent at or above this usage.

schema.label: OpenRouter key command
schema.description: Optional command that prints the key, e.g. 'pass show openrouter/api-key'. Empty: OPENROUTER_API_KEY or ~/.config/omarchy/openrouter/key.
